name: crossword
description: A fullscreen crossword studio where ChatGPT sets a fresh themed puzzle for every conversation.

interface.longDescription: A distraction-free four-mode puzzle desk: Words (crossword), Numbers (Sudoku), Code (colour code breaker), and Math (a math crossword with + − × ÷), each with Easy, Standard, and Hard. Numbers, Code, and Math show permanent How to play strips. The Words view keeps the per-word check switch and ChatGPT-set crosswords; the other modes are local puzzles. The complete UI is localized into the 54 ChatGPT desktop locales, with host-locale detection, a language menu, and RTL support. Each mode includes 50 playable samples and a New puzzle action that sends an English prompt; local modes use puzzle_generate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Make me a new crossword about the night sky.
